operator_scope: live camera, NON-DESTRUCTIVE: the camera's frame was read as the codec's source and never written; the destination and its guards were in our own retained block; seg was never touched and the frame reached the card as it would have. One recording. Hook self-restored, block released with free_result 0.
question: was the reduced geometry why the engine refused on 2026-09-26?
verdict: YES. At 1936x1090 the encode succeeds; at 1536x736 it returned 0.

measured.sum_checks_out: the twelve sizes add to 790,528 = 0xC1000, which is what the probe reported
measured.ratio_vs_stock: 3,244,544 -> 870,400 with a header, 3.73x. A darker, flatter scene than the 2.197x of C2.

what_this_settles.claim: the engine refuses a geometry it was not configured for. 1536x736 with six 512x368 tiles was chosen only so a generated source and a destination would both fit in one 4 MiB block; F_INIT accepted it and F_ENC returned 0. The same probe at 1936x1090 with twelve tiles returns 1.
what_this_settles.corroborates: the engine is a single global configured for the current mode. Every successful encode in this project has used the sensor geometry.

what_this_does_NOT_settle.claim: the bound is still untested, exactly as predicted before the run
what_this_does_NOT_settle.why: a real frame compresses. This one used 25.0% of the declared length, so five intact guards say only that nothing wrote 3.17 MB when it had 790 KB to write. The declared length readback of 0x305000 is confirmed for a third time, but confirming the NUMBER is not confirming that the engine STOPS there.

a_corroboration_found_offline_the_same_d.claim: 0x305000 was this project's ORIGINAL WORK_CAP. 3,166,208 - 3,165,360 = 848, which matches the note's 'the old 0x305000 sat 848 B above the packed raster' exactly. Whoever chose it was setting the arena to the engine's own declared output length.
a_corroboration_found_offline_the_same_d.and_a_misreading_corrected: the same note says a noisy frame 'overran the guard and destroyed the size table'. That sentence is in output-bound-20260923.json, which records camera_accessed: false - it is hazard analysis, not an observation. NO overrun at 0x305000 has ever been measured, so it is not evidence against the bound.

what_testing_the_bound_now_requires: the product geometry, since the engine refuses anything else
incompressible content AT that geometry, which cannot be the camera's frame - so a source we generate, 3,165,696 bytes
a destination of 3,166,208 plus guards, also ours

6.33 MB together, so TWO 4 MiB blocks. A second allocation succeeded on 2026-09-26 at 0x45578800, so the allocator will give one; the scratch preflight would need to retain two, or the probe would have to allocate the second itself.
explicitly_not_established: whether the engine respects its declared output length. Three runs have now confirmed what the length IS and none has tested whether it is enforced.
what exactly refuses a non-sensor geometry, and whether any geometry other than the configured one is accepted
the read-versus-write pointer race, still untested
that the LCG source is incompressible to this codec; it has never reached the encoder

corrections.found_by: notes/CURRENT_DEVELOPMENT.md section 2, which spotted that the twelve tile sizes recorded here do not add up to the total recorded here
corrections.verdict: A TRANSCRIPTION ERROR IN THIS LEDGER, NOT A DEVICE DISAGREEMENT
corrections.what_was_wrong: tile 2 is recorded as 75,012. The probe read back 0x00012484, which is 74,884. I converted it wrongly when writing this entry, and 75,012 - 74,884 = 128, which is exactly the discrepancy the note found.

the_readback_resolves_it.note_said: 'no original dump or log was found in the project that resolves the contradiction' - the hex readback IS that record, and it does resolve it

corrections.what_this_means_for_the_derived_numbers: the sum was never wrong, so payload 790,528 and 25.0% of the declared 3,166,208 stand. The '3.73x smaller' figure used 790,528 + 79,872 = 870,400 and also stands arithmetically - but the note is right to set it aside for a different reason: this variant never built a file, so a compression ratio for it is a calculation, not a measurement.
corrections.lesson: hex is what the device reports; a decimal column written beside it by hand is a second source that can be wrong on its own.
